m.post: Refer to the Sanctum of Rebirth strategy guide for information on the fight. If desired, a blood reaver or hellhound familiar to replace the ripper demon may also suffice. The runes factored in include five uses of darkness, assuming complete runs of the Sanctum of Rebirth being less than 12 minutes, along with various uses of Invoke Death for the bosses, alongside both forms of Nephtys and both of Kezalam's obelisks, and Split Soul being used once at Vermyx and twice at Kezalam and Nakatra. m.t: Completing Soul Reaper tasks
m.pg: Money making guide/Completing Soul Reaper tasks

rq.h: or 90 Attack, 90 Ranged, 90 Magic, or 90 Necromancy
or T80+ magic equipment or T80+ ranged equipment
High-level PvM items and unlocks recommended (like Sunshine, Enhanced Excalibur)

m.h:
The inputs above are an example and may vary significantly with the boss chosen and/or your levels and prowess.

Completing Soul Reaper tasks from Death is a very profitable weekly, as each completed task rewards reaper points which are valued at 31909697/300 round 0 gp. The profit listed above is purely from purchasing an incomplete hydrix once you have 300 reaper points. The drops from the bosses will increase the profit further.

Each task awards between 7 and 39 reaper points, with the higher values obtained from completing the highest tier pvm content in the game. However since there is no limit to the number of reaper tasks that players can complete, maximising points gained does not require completing the hardest pvm content. There is a limit of 300 reaper points that can be earned per week, so it does not strictly matter which bosses you kill. To minimise the amount of time required to obtain 300 reaper points:

  • Enable group tasks for soul reaper, as this gives 25% increased points for all tasks
  • Disable extended tasks, as this makes each task take twice as long for only 25% increased points
  • Bring a Grim gem while completing the task, to obtain a following task without having to return to Death's office
  • If given Reaper's choice, it is often faster overall to choose a mid level boss (relative to the player's skill level) with a task that can be completed in a few minutes, rather than a higher level boss that might take significantly longer for a relatively small increase in points.

Reaching higher tiers of Combat Mastery gives you an increasing chance of 'Reaper's Choice', where you get to choose the boss for your task, maxing out at 100%. This allows you player to focus on only the bosses you want to kill; otherwise, you can spend 30 slayer points to reroll a task.

With 100% chance of reapers choice, the fastest method to reach 300 reaper points is to complete the Dagannoth Kings soul reaper task 17 times, which requires an average of 170 kills. This is due to the fact that dagannoth kings have low health, so can be killed quickly, and one can be killed while the other 2 are respawning. As an alternative, the Chaos Elemental soul reaper task can be completed 38 times, for an average of 171 kills, but more time will be spent waiting for it to respawn.

m.t: Completing the Fight Kiln
m.pg: Money making guide/Completing the Fight Kiln

rq.h: or 90 Attack and 90 Strength, or 90 Magic, or 90 Ranged
92 Prayer (95 Prayer (recommended))
96 Herblore (98 Herblore (recommended))
Tier 90+ Attack melee weapon, Ranged ranged weapon or Magic magic weapon
Tier 90+ Attack melee armour, Ranged ranged armour or Magic mage armour (Obsidian equipment recommended)

rq.nt: or better (On toolbelt only works when using a melee weapon)

rq.h: Have sacrificed a Fire cape for entry into the Kiln

m.h:
This guide assumes 2 Kiln completions per hour on fast spawns with cutscenes disabled; your actual profit per hour will vary with different completion speeds.

Completing the Fight Kiln gives the player a choice of one of two rewards: the TokHaar-Kal or an uncut onyx. Completing this minigame is the fastest way to earn an uncut onyx and the only guaranteed method.

Most of the monsters pose no threat with high level gear and stats. This makes most of the waves straightforward combat against multiple enemies. For the most part, having Soul Split active the entire time will heal back any damage taken. Attack enemies (with a specific weakness) with the side of the combat triangle they are weak to, or else you will deal half damage to those enemies.

At the beginning of every even numbered wave, a crystal will spawn in the centre of the arena. There are 6 crystals, and each crystal appears 3 times. Magic, Ranged, and Strength crystals raise their respective stat to 150% (148 at level 99), but lower defence, the other offensive stats (excluding attack) to 48. Using stat restoration of any kind will not remedy this decrease, as the stats are lowered again every few seconds. These crystals are not useful and should not be picked up.

The other 3 crystals are restoration, invulnerability, and constitution. These crystals can prove very useful in a pinch. The invulnerability crystals prove to be especially useful on wave 36.

Only 2 monsters pose any real threat in the Fight Kiln: TokHaar-Ket-Dill and TokHaar-Jad. The latter, however, can have its damage completely nullified if the correct deflection curse is put on in time. When TokHaar-Jad swiftly slams the ground with his front two feet, turn on Deflect Ranged. When he pulls his head inwards and then stands on his hind legs, turn on Deflect Magic. All other monsters during that wave can be ignored as you fight TokHaar-Jad, as they should not deal a significant amount of damage. Wave 36 is comprised of 2 TokHaar-Jad. This can be handled either by luring one around the rock in the centre of the field and taking down the other without interruption, or by using an invulnerability crystal to temporarily avoid all damage. It is worth saving a crystal for this, as it has limited uses when you can rely on Soul Split to heal. TokHaar-Jad appears on waves 10, 20, 30, 34, 35, and twice on wave 36.

TokHaar-Ket-Dill are the only monsters that will deal a dangerous amount of damage. They must first have their armour chipped off by attacking them with a Elder rune pickaxe + 5 Your accuracy affects your ability to damage their armour. Alternatively, using a melee weapon while having the pickaxe on the tool belt will also chip off its armour. If you have a steel titan or other familiar, it can deal damage even when the armour is not yet broken. After a few hits from the pickaxe, their armour breaks and damage can be dealt to them normally. Switch from your pickaxe to your staff to deal with them effectively. Every so often, TokHaar-Ket-Dill use their special attack (which is prompted in the chatbox as "The TokHaar-Ket-Dill slams the ground."), dealing around 1,500 life points. This damage cannot be avoided or protected against, even with an invulnerability crystal. Using prayers or curses provokes them to use this attack more often, so these should be avoided when in combat with them. TokHaar-ket-Dill appear on waves 5, 19, and six times on wave 28.

After completing waves 10, 20, 30, 33, and 36, there will be a short intermission and the size of the arena will shrink. This cutscene can be skipped by clicking anywhere outside of the chat box or alternatively toggled off by right-clicking the Kiln's entrance and selecting Toggle cutscenes before starting. After wave 36 is completed, Har-Aken, the final monster to defeat, will appear.

Har-Aken has 150,000 life points and will only surface from the lava every 72 seconds. Attacking the tentacles will not affect his head appearing; however, it is recommended to attack them with Soul Split active to mitigate any damage they may deal. When Har-Aken's head resurfaces, refocus your attacks on it. Build up adrenaline before it appears, activate a magic crystal, and use Onslaught until you must cancel it. Build back to 100% adrenaline on the tentacles and use Sunshine and a Replenishment potion when the head resurfaces. After Har-Aken is defeated, you will be offered your reward. If you click anywhere during this cutscene, you will exit the cave back to TzHaar City, but you may re-enter the cave to the Fight Kiln and speak with TokHaar-Hok to claim your prize. There is a bank immediately outside the entrance to the Fight Kiln, so it is quick to restock for subsequent playthroughs.

or Archaeological soil box or Auto-screener v1.080 or Flow State

rq.nt: or better (augmented mattock and mattock precision upgrades recommended)

xp.nt: from completing the restorations, more from digging materials

m.h:
Completing the Zamorakian I collection has a high output of chronotes. This assumes that you complete a collection in an hour (could take more or less time depending on stats/gear). Profit assumes buying the remaining materials, estimated at half of the total cost of materials (more than half for some of the more rare mats to obtain while collecting artefacts, and less than half for some of the more common). Profit will be higher or lower depending on level/gear/materials obtained per artefact.

After turning in your first set of artefacts to Isaura, all subsequent sets should be turned in to the museum for maximum chronotes.

It is usually best to gather enough artefacts to do 2-3 collections at once. Just be sure to have at least one backpack space when you hand in the collection.

m.t: Making wooden frames (from logs) in Fort Forinthry
m.pg: Money making guide/Constructing frames from logs at Fort Forinthry
m.h:
After completion of New Foundations, you may utilise the sawmill next to Bill to process your Planks into Refined Planks and Frames.

The profit rate assumes 120 frames per hour. Your actual profit may be slightly higher or lower depending on your speed.

m.t: Crafting air runes through Barbarian Village
m.pg: Money making guide/Crafting air runes (free-to-play)

rq.h: 1 Runecrafting (99 Runecrafting (recommended))

m.h:
Set up a preset with the required items equipped and an inventory filled with 28 pure essence. Create an action bar with the skull sceptre's Barbarian Village teleport option and War's Retreat Teleport keybound.

  1. Use the keybind to teleport Barbarian Village using your skull sceptre.
  2. Navigate to the air altar. If you have level 5 Agility you can use surge to speed up your run.
  3. Enter the air altar and click it to create air runes.
  4. After crafting your runes, use War's Retreat Teleport to bank.
  5. Reload your preset and repeat the process.

m.t: Crafting air runes through the Abyss
m.pg: Money making guide/Crafting air runes through the Abyss

inp.nt: Untradeable. Using calculated value from materials.

out.nt: The number of times that powerburst of sorcery can be used per hour cannot exceed 30; for less than 30 trips per hour the amount of additional runes crafted with the help of a powerburst may be less than shown.

m.h:
The numbers listed assumes using the expansive pouch, the Infinity ethereal outfit, and the Abyssal Titan, and running 81 trips per hour while using the powerburst of sorcery every fourth trip. It also assumes that the player has completed the Elite Wilderness tasks to increase magical thread chance.

With optimised dives and surges, one can expect around 100–120 trips an hour, while without using any mobility abilities, one can expect 81–94 trips an hour.

Using the expansive pouch, an Abyssal titan, the full Infinity ethereal outfit, and reserving one space for a Powerburst of sorcery, you can hold up to 128 essence per trip, resulting in a profit of 35,200 coins per trip (assuming 110 Runecrafting).

The Mage of Zamorak is located in low-level wilderness, near the source of the River Lum. Make sure PvP is toggled off by talking to Vala in Edgeville. The suggested outfit is as follows (make sure enhanced excalibur has the Mobile perk and Wilderness sword is in the inventory):

A typical trip would look like:

  1. Open bank and load preset, or load last preset
  2. Run to wilderness wall (surge when you can do so in a straight line to the wall)
  3. Cross the wall
  4. Dive immediately after crossing the wall.
  5. Surge after passing the tree to go deeper into the wilderness
  6. Click on Zamorak mage to teleport (you can configure teleport to be the left-click option by right-clicking him and selecting configure)
  7. Angle yourself in the Abyss and activate Surge to go diagonal toward the air portal.
  8. Drink a powerburst of sorcery if off cooldown, then craft the runes
  9. Teleport to Edgeville bank with the wilderness sword.
  10. Repeat from step 1

Here is the list of possible boosts to number of runes crafted:

  • Ring of imbuing for 10% more rune output
  • Arcane apoterrasaur (player-owned farm) perk for +2 rune multiplier
  • Hero's Welcome quest, when completed, offers a 5% boost

Other helpful items and abilities:

  • Nexus Mod relic will change the Zamorak mage's teleport so that you arrive an the centre of the Abyss
  • Pouch Protector relic will prevent pouches from degrading
  • Dive and Double Surge codex allow for faster trips by speeding up movement
